title: ageratina pampalcensis
intro: Ageratina pampalcensis, commonly known as San Nicolas, is a plant species within the mint family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, potentially aiding in the relief of pain and the reduction of oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina pampalcensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, specific information on the bioactive constituents of this plant is limited, and further research is needed to fully understand its properties and potential uses.
